facts.assertion: Enfield Cabinet approved the Housing Delivery and Placemaking Ten-Year Plan on 25 February 2026.
The 2026-2036 plan provides a roadmap for 3,000 high-quality affordable homes over the next decade.
Alma Estate regeneration has delivered 679 new homes since regeneration began in 2015.
The current Alma programme is delivering 1,402 homes in total after revisions to the original 993-home masterplan.
Alma Phases 2B and 3 are planned to deliver a further 723 homes.
On completion Alma is planned to include 444 affordable homes, including 246 social-rent homes.
The current Alma programme expects overall completion in summer 2032.
Alma early demolition works are taking place and construction of council social-rent homes is due to start in September 2026.
The first tranche of Alma social-rent homes is forecast to complete in March 2029.
Dendridge Close is proposed to deliver 27 social-rent homes.
Planning consent for Dendridge Close was granted on 10 April 2026.
Joyce Avenue and Snell's Park regeneration is planned to provide more than 2,000 new homes, with 50% affordable.
Planning permission for Joyce Avenue and Snell's Park was granted in July 2025.
Hill Partnerships was appointed main contractor for the first Joyce and Snell's phases in March 2026.
Construction of Joyce and Snell's Block A is underway and the first new homes are expected to be handed over in 2028.
Enfield's February 2026 Joyce and Snell's decision revised a forthcoming phase from 148 homes to 220 homes to bring delivery forward.
The Joyce and Snell's project update states construction of the first new homes started on 2 June 2026.
Meridian Water aims to deliver 10,000 homes and thousands of jobs over the lifetime of the programme.
Meridian One A is complete with 301 homes and the council says more than 90% are affordable.
Planning permission has been granted for Meridian One's second phase, planned to deliver 676 homes; this project permission is separate from candidate 30762 parcel allocation.
